reason: The hypothesis transfers the nanolayered graphene crack-arresting concept from the CoCrFeNi system (P9, P15) to a completely different MM'X-type caloric alloy, (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38, and proposes that the caloric phase transition will be preserved, a combination not suggested in any passage. This constitutes a synthesis of a mechanical reinforcement strategy with a functional caloric material, going beyond the original mechanical-only context.
